# Media

What the client loads (TGA only; PNG masters are gitignored).

## Glass material (copies — do not edit here)

`body_mask*`, `rim5*`, `rim_dark5*`, `shadow*`, `bar_*`, `gloss`, `grain`, `sheen2`, `track_fade`:
generated by `Tools/make_textures.py`, copied from `..\GlassUnitFrames` `main`
(`git -C ..\GlassUnitFrames show main:Media/<name>.tga`). `tests/test_toc.lua` checks they exist.

## Tiles (ours, generated by a script)

The **Classic** theme's tiles (the Modern theme's, `tile_modern_*`, are generated art: below).
`tile_covered`, `tile_exploded`, `tile_revealed`, `tile_hover`: 32x32 TGAs from
`Tools/make_tiles.py` (`python Tools/make_tiles.py --preview x.png` writes a magnified contact
sheet to look at). Shared by every tile; the generator is the source of truth. They aren't copies,
so `tests/test_toc.lua`'s drift check skips the `tile_` prefix and instead checks that every
texture the skin names exists.

## UI textures (ours, generated by a script)

`icon_flag`, `icon_clock`, `icon_trophy`, `icon_music`, `icon_mute`, `icon_sound`, `icon_close`, `icon_arrow`, `icon_burst`,
`fx_glow`, `fx_smoke`, `ui_fill`, `ui_border`, `ui_glow`, `face_ring`: `Tools/make_ui.py`
(`--preview x.png` for a contact sheet). `icon_flag` is the board's pennant, the trophy a brass cup
like the clock (the best times button), the burst is the fireworks' shape, `fx_*` are the win's glow and the wipe's smoke (#10),
`ui_*` are the 9-sliced glass button parts (margin 8), the face ring and the white icons are tinted
at runtime. The generator is the source of truth. (`face_sparkle` and `face_soot` stood in for the
expressions until the generated art below, and are gone.)

## The mascot's face

`face_mascot`: the green-haired gnome, cut from the logo as a 64x64 circle:

    python Tools/png_to_tga.py docs/logo.png face_mascot --size 64 --circle --crop 370,60,910,600

The ready face (the grin). The other expressions are the generated art below (#12).

## Gnomesweeper art (#12)

Generated 2026-10-03 (Codex, its image tool) from `docs/ART.md`, `docs/logo.png`, the owner's
green-haired gnome screenshots and Warcraft Rumble style references: silver hoop earrings, green
pigtails and eyes, brass goggles, a red collar. **The prompts are in [ART-PROMPTS.md](ART-PROMPTS.md).**
The full-resolution originals are in `Media/Source/Generated/` (ignored by git, as all of
`Media/Source/` and every PNG: about 66 MB of masters, references and previews stay local).

**In the game** (`Skin.TEXTURES`): the four expressions, the title lettering, the laurels, and the
three tiles as the **Modern** theme (#14, owner: `tile_modern_covered|revealed|exploded`, renamed by
`export_art.py`'s `THEMED` so the Classic tiles from `make_tiles.py` stay). **Staged, not used**
(`Media/Source/GameTextures/`): the mine, the exploded mine and the flag (on the board, in both
themes, WoW's bomb and the pennant read better: at tile size the generated mine is a small brass
gear, owner, 2026-10-03).

### Export

From the repository root, one command makes every texture from the originals:

```powershell
python Tools/export_art.py
```

It sizes each original into `Media/Source/<name>.png`, then writes the adopted pieces to `Media/`
and the staged tiles to `Media/Source/GameTextures/` (its `ADOPTED` list says which). Square pieces
go through `Tools/png_to_tga.py` (faces 64x64 `--circle`; mine, exploded mine, flag 32x32 `--trim`;
tiles 32x32 `--margin 0`); the title and laurels (512x128) are trimmed to their drawn part, fitted
without stretching, and written by `make_textures.write_tga` (Pillow's TGA writer appends a 26-byte
footer `tests/test_media.lua` rejects). Adapted from the script Codex wrote with the art; its
exports and this script's are byte-identical (checked 2026-10-03).

In the game the title is cropped to its drawn pixels (53..459 x 4..124: `Skin.TITLE_CROP`) so it
lines up with the tagline.
